messages:
vivian: Quick sync 1 I added a short table to the Dedicated SLA doc that quantifies expected latency uplift during fallback (p50/p95/p99 delta). Also added a tiny 'telemetry & smoke tests' appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

maria: can you paste the smoke curl example and the telemetry tag naming convention here? easier to review quickly.

vivian: sure. kept it compact:

Telemetry naming (recommended):
- routing.fallback = <playbook-id>  # e.g., eu-rollover-180
- model.variant = <name>
- routing.trigger = p99_latency_ms

Smoke curl (validate function-call & labels):

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dispatch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-small-quant","input":"toolcall test","tools":[{"name":"echo","schema":{}}],"metadata":{"test_run":"fallback-smoke"}}' \
| jq -r '.meta.labels | .["routing.fallback"] + " " + .["model.variant"]'
```

Expect output: `eu-rollover-180 gpt-small-quant` and a `function_call_ok` field in the response body.

keith: runtime note: also check KV cache hit ratio after switching variants; add `cache.prefix_hit:true` to smoke validations if possible. Cold starts are common and should be documented.

runtime-eng: agreed. compatibility_check should verify tool schema and context_window >= requested_length before routing. Otherwise function-calls can fail silently.

maria: docs nit: the SLA table needs a short footnote that commercial/legal SLA language may differ; link to /handbook/sales/enterprise-sla-summary instead of the private PDF.

docs-bot: link-check: docs/dedicated/sla.md line 102: internal link /handbook/legal/sla.pdf flagged private. Recommendation: link to /handbook/sales/enterprise-sla-summary for public docs.

vivian: thanks, will swap link and add a footnote about commercial SLA differences. I'll also add a one-line paragraph recommending 72h retention for fallback telemetry.

keith: small suggestion: include a compact CSV example of the SLA delta table so pm/product can copy-paste into decks.

vivian: adding CSV snippet: `region,trigger_ms,p50_delta_ms,p95_delta_ms,p99_delta_ms\neu,180,10,40,120`

maria: perfect. I'll do a final pass tomorrow morning and merge if no more comments. :thumbsup:

vivian: awesome, thanks all. merging after the link swap and adding KV cache note.
